The '''1953–54 Danish 1st Division''' season was the 9th edition of [[Danish 1st Division]] annual [[Association football|football]] competition in Denmark. It was contested by 10 teams.

[[Kjøbenhavns Boldklub]] unsuccessfully defended its [[1952–53 Danish 1st Division|1953 title]]. [[Køge BK]] successfully pursued its 1954 title.

Statistics of [[Danish 1st Division]] in the 1953/1954 season.
